subject: Why your high notes strain, and 6 more posts
preview_text: There is something here for your pitch, your breath and your next release.
body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "friend" }},

Some weeks it is your voice that won't behave. Other weeks it is your nerves, your songs or your money. Each of these new posts takes one problem and gives you something to try.

Your congregation is not your audience. They are your choir.
If people watch you instead of singing with you, this gives you a simple test to run on Sunday.
https://blog.joshuaediale.com/posts/congregation-is-not-your-audience/

The panel of judges in your head
Nerves are normal. This is about the pressure to impress, and what to do about it before Sunday.
https://blog.joshuaediale.com/posts/panel-of-judges-in-your-head/

Stop shouting your high notes
Top notes feeling tight or shouty? Here is why, and what to practise this week.
https://blog.joshuaediale.com/posts/stop-shouting-your-high-notes/

Your song bank is too small
If you go blank when you are asked for another song, there is a 7-day plan to fix it.
https://blog.joshuaediale.com/posts/your-song-bank-is-too-small/

Did you really sing it in tune?
Not sure your own ears can be trusted? This one gives you a 5-day plan to check.
https://blog.joshuaediale.com/posts/did-you-really-sing-it-in-tune/

₦2 a stream: the honest maths of Spotify
Planning a release? Do the sum first, then ask yourself the 5 questions in this post.
https://blog.joshuaediale.com/posts/two-naira-a-stream/

Your breath has a budget
Run out of air halfway through a line? You are usually spending it too fast. Here is how to slow down.
https://blog.joshuaediale.com/posts/your-breath-has-a-budget/

{{ subscriber.first_name | default: "friend" }}, you don't need to read them all today. Pick the one that sounds most like you right now and start there.

Which one of these would help you most this week? Hit reply and tell me.

Joshua Ediale
MusicMentor by Joshua Ediale
